## Key facts recovered (from Tom's Hardware)

- Trump administration plans a **voluntary investment consortium targeting $4 trillion** for energy projects, critical minerals, and semiconductor supply chains (per a **New York Times** report).
- **US government contributes $250 million** and will administer the pool of capital.
- Outlined by **Jacob Helberg** (Under Secretary of State for economic growth, energy, environment) at a Hill and Valley Forum breakfast in Washington; framed as an expansion of Pax Silica (launched Dec 2025).
- **Founding members: SoftBank, Temasek (Singapore), Mubadala (Abu Dhabi)** — collectively managing **> $1 trillion in combined assets**.
- Also includes sovereign wealth funds from Singapore, UAE, Qatar, Sweden.
- Pax Silica now counts **13 member countries** (Japan, South Korea, Israel, Netherlands, UK, Australia, India, Greece, ...).
- $250M = 0.00625% of the $4T goal; total global FDI last year was $1.6T (UN stats via NYT).
- Catalysts: China's rare-earth export controls; Strait of Hormuz shipping disruption.
